Geometry shaders are supported since OpenGL ES 3.2 and most devices i ever worked with, even cheap mobile phones from 2019 do support OpenGL ES 3.2+, let alone desktop devices.
Unfortunately, to have such a tool that provides near 99% of efficiency right in Godot remains only a dream. The chip silicone and graphics APIs has this already implemented but they stay unutilized.
